title: Design System: OnDemand Monitor Customer Portal

headline.purpose: Compact, strong page titles in the customer portal.

body.purpose: Readable customer-facing labels, explanations, and navigation.

label.purpose: Small field labels and supporting data headings.

shadows.name: panel-resting
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation on shared portal cards outside the flat overview.

shadows.name: panel-hover
shadows.purpose: Light hover lift on shared interactive surfaces.

shadows.name: mobile-sidebar
shadows.purpose: Separates the temporary mobile sidebar overlay.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Use for the main action on a portal screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 38px; padding: 4px 15px; border: 1px solid #1565E8; border-radius: 10px; background: #1565E8; color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0958d9; border-color: #0958d9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1565E8; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #0b4bbd; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Use for secondary actions beside a primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { min-height: 38px; padding: 4px 15px; border: 1px solid #E6ECF5; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #0F1B3D; font: 600 14px/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-default:hover { border-color: #1565E8; color: #1565E8; } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1565E8; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-default:active { background: #F6F8FD; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Use for searching orders, missions, or locations.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" type="search" aria-label="Tìm đơn, nhiệm vụ" placeholder="Tìm đơn, nhiệm vụ..." />
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 100%; height: 38px; padding: 4px 11px; border: 1px solid #E6ECF5; border-radius: 12px; background: #F6F8FD; color: #0F1B3D; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Be Vietnam Pro', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: #64748B; } .ds-input-search:focus-visible { border-color: #1565E8; outline: 2px solid rgb(21 101 232 / 18%); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Selected Navigation Item
components.description: Marks the current section in the customer sidebar.
components.css: .ds-nav-selected { display: flex; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(21, 101, 232, 0.09); color: #1565E8; font: 600 14px/1.4 'Be Vietnam Pro', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-selected:hover { background: rgba(21, 101, 232, 0.13); } .ds-nav-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1565E8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pair a concise status label with a soft semantic tint and a leading dot.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; min-height: 24px; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #e6f4ff; color: #1677ff; font: 600 12.5px/1.4 'Be Vietnam Pro', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

narrative.overview:
This document describes the customer-facing portal and its shared shell. The visual direction is compact, light, and progress-clear: customers should be able to scan records, read the next step, and move into an order without competing decoration. “The Clear Flightline” names that calm operational clarity, using the supplied product direction and the portal’s drone-monitoring context.

Be Vietnam Pro is the primary face because it is loaded with Vietnamese character support. Navy text, pale blue-gray surroundings, and white work surfaces keep the interface quiet. Blue marks actions and selected navigation; semantic colors stay on status labels and other small signals. Thin borders do most of the separating, with elevation kept light and selective.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, scannable information hierarchy with clear progress cues.
Blue is reserved for primary actions, links, and selected navigation.
Pale blue-gray canvas, white surfaces, and fine cool borders.
Vietnamese and English labels remain readable and allowed to wrap.
Status colors are muted and attached to labeled statuses.

rules.name: The Clear Flightline Rule
rules.body: Give customers a quiet route from the current state to the next useful action.

rules.name: The Action Blue Rule
rules.body: Keep the primary blue for actions, links, and selection; use semantic color only to clarify status.

rules.name: The Wrap-Safe Rule
rules.body: Use weight and spacing for hierarchy, and let longer Vietnamese or English text wrap without clipping.

rules.name: The Narrow-to-Wide Rule
rules.body: Preserve the reading order as columns collapse, and move essential dates into the order details when the table date column disappears.

rules.name: The Quiet Boundary Rule
rules.body: Let the overview use spacing and a fine border to separate panels; reserve stronger shadows for overlays.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Use soft corners and a light border to define a surface; add another container only when it clarifies a distinct content group.

rules.name: The Labeled State Rule
rules.body: Keep status text visible beside its color, and keep actions recognizable through concise labels and familiar button shapes.

rules.name: The Content Before Chrome Rule
rules.body: A count, status, or next step should remain easier to scan than the visual treatment around it.

dos: Do use the existing blue primary and pale blue-gray portal neutrals.
Do keep order counts, status labels, and action controls compact and easy to scan.
Do use semantic colors with a visible text label and preserve the source-defined light and dark theme values.
Do allow English and Vietnamese interface copy to wrap without clipping.
Do retain thin borders as the main separator on the customer overview.
donts: Don't add a new accent palette or decorative gradients to ordinary customer work surfaces.
Don't rely on color alone to explain an order or mission status.
Don't add strong stacked shadows to the customer overview cards.
Don't use tight fixed-width labels that clip Vietnamese diacritics or longer English copy.
